environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment with 4 replicas. An Envoy sidecar proxy (istio-proxy) intercepts all inbound traffic on port 8080 via iptables REDIRECT rules. The Envoy filter chain includes a Lua filter that appends response headers. The relevant VirtualService has a headers.response.set policy adding 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src self; script-src self; object-src none' to all responses matching prefix '/dashboard'. The Envoy access log confirms the header is injected post-handler. Note: the race condition in the Kafka consumer path remains unmitigated — the CSP header only addresses the reflected content injection vector on the dashboard endpoint. The Kafka topic still has 8 partitions with round-robin rebalancing across 4 pods.
